Messages.Author: Ray Babbitt
Messages.Body:
Question: The card "Heidelburg Castle, Germany" states "Tap to transfer
equipment cards, move blood, and transfer retainers between any two
ready vampires you control. (You may choose the amount of blood you move
and which cards you transfer.)" When am I allowed to do this? May I
use it during combat? If not, then may I use it after I have been
blocked -- or after I have blocked -- but before combat begins?

Thanks for the input!

Ray Babbitt
RBab...@Novell.COM

Standard Disclaimer

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
Ray Babbitt <RBab...@Novell.COM> writes:
>Question: The card "Heidelburg Castle, Germany" states "Tap to transfer
>equipment cards, move blood, and transfer retainers between any two
>ready vampires you control. (You may choose the amount of blood you move
>and which cards you transfer.)" When am I allowed to do this? May I
>use it during combat? If not, then may I use it after I have been
>blocked -- or after I have blocked -- but before combat begins?

It has errata stating that it may not be used to transfer anything
to or from a minion engaged in combat. You may still use it after a
block and before the resulting combat.

Messages.Author: Steve Bucy
Messages.Body:
Ray Babbitt <RBab...@Novell.COM> wrote:
>Question: The card "Heidelburg Castle, Germany" states "Tap to transfer
>equipment cards, move blood, and transfer retainers between any two
>ready vampires you control. (You may choose the amount of blood you move
>and which cards you transfer.)" When am I allowed to do this? May I
>use it during combat? If not, then may I use it after I have been
>blocked -- or after I have blocked -- but before combat begins?

If I am correct the current ruling states you can use it at any time
except during combat. Thus you could use it to transfer weopons after you
are blocked, but before combat begins. I guess it would be at the same
time you play Thoughts Betrayed.

Steve Bucy

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:

>Ray Babbitt <RBab...@Novell.COM> wrote:
>>Question: The card "Heidelburg Castle, Germany" states "Tap to transfer

>If I am correct the current ruling states you can use it at any time
>except during combat. Thus you could use it to transfer weopons after you
>are blocked, but before combat begins.

Yes.

>I guess it would be at the same time you play Thoughts Betrayed.

No. TB is played as combat is entered - which is the beginning of
the restricted time for HC.

(The "before" wording means "at the start", just as the "after" wording
on Draw the Beast has been ruled to mean "at the end").
